description: Searches THIS server's own tool catalogue by keyword and returns the best-matching tool names with their descriptions, ranked. Use it FIRST whenever you are unsure which tool does a job, instead of guessing a name and getting "Tool not found" -- this catalogue has hundreds of tools and searching it is far more reliable than scanning it. Matches against tool names and descriptions (lexical, not semantic, so prefer a domain noun like "marker", "proxy", "lumetri", "caption", "keyframe" over a full sentence). Reports how many tools were searched, and honestly flags any match that exists in this build but is hidden by the active tool profile as exposed:false rather than omitting it, so a curated deployment cannot look like a missing capability. Read-only: makes no Premiere request and changes nothing.

includeHidden.description: Include matches hidden by the active tool profile, flagged exposed:false (default true)

includeParameters.description: Include each match's parameter names (default false, to keep the response small)

query.description: Keyword(s) describing the job, e.g. "marker", "audio fade", "export preset", "offline media"

readOnly.description: Only return inspection tools (name begins with get/list/read/find/search/inspect/is/check/detect/probe/validate/verify/lint/diff). Naming heuristic, not a capability guarantee.

name: find_tool
